Aesthetic Dental Designs, P.A. (operating commercially as Dental Arts of Atlantis) is a fully licensed and accredited dental healthcare corporation headquartered at 5057 S Congress Ave, Suite 401, Lake Worth Beach, Florida (NPI: 1235501420).
The practice is anchored by a distinguished clinical team, featuring Dr. Colleen Lam, D.M.D. and Dr. Serrano. The organization provides comprehensive clinical infrastructure specializing in advanced restorative, cosmetic, and multi-generational family dentistry. Its core competencies include high-precision digital prosthodontics, advanced smile designs, complex full-mouth reconstructions, and systematic preventive oral healthcare.
Operating under a patient-centric administrative framework, Aesthetic Dental Designs, P.A. integrates cutting-edge dental technologies with rigorous clinical protocols. The enterprise maintains an established track record of therapeutic excellence, operational integrity, and superior patient outcomes within the South Florida healthcare market.

Rahnuma-FPAP is one of the largest and oldest civil society organizations in Pakistan focused on reproductive health and contraceptive care. The organization aims to empower individuals to make informed decisions about their sexual and reproductive health rights. It provides a wide range of services including family planning, HIV/AIDS care, gynecology, and obstetrics, particularly targeting vulnerable and underserved populations. Rahnuma-FPAP operates a network of clinics across Pakistan, ensuring accessible and confidential health services for all individuals.
